CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `categories` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `iconRes` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sortOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, `published` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `topics` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `difficulty` TEXT NOT NULL, `sampleQuestionCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `formulaPreview` TEXT NOT NULL, `sortOrder` INTEGER NOT NULL, `published` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `questions` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicId` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `difficulty` TEXT NOT NULL, `languageCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `questionText` TEXT NOT NULL, `optionsJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `correctOptionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `explanation` TEXT NOT NULL, `hint` TEXT NOT NULL, `extraHint` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `published` INTEGER NOT NULL, `version` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updatedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `practice_sessions` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `ownerId` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicId` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, `categoryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `difficultyFilter` TEXT NOT NULL, `requestedQuestionCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `currentQuestionIndex` INTEGER NOT NULL, `score` INTEGER NOT NULL, `accuracyPercentage` REAL NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `completedAt` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `session_question_snapshots` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `sessionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `questionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `questionText` TEXT NOT NULL, `optionsJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `correctOptionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `explanation` TEXT NOT NULL, `hint` TEXT NOT NULL, `extraHint` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `isExtraHintUnlocked` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `selectedOptionId` TEXT, `isSubmitted` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isBookmarked` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `bookmarks` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `ownerId` TEXT NOT NULL, `questionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicId` TEXT NOT NULL, `topicTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, `questionText` TEXT NOT NULL, `optionsJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `correctOptionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `explanation` TEXT NOT NULL, `hint` TEXT NOT NULL, `extraHint` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mock_tests` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `questionIdsJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `durationSeconds` INTEGER NOT NULL, `marksPerCorrect` INTEGER NOT NULL, `published` INTEGER NOT NULL, `version` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mock_question_snapshots` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `attemptId` TEXT NOT NULL, `questionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `position` INTEGER NOT NULL, `questionText` TEXT NOT NULL, `optionsJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `correctOptionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `explanation` TEXT NOT NULL, `hint` TEXT NOT NULL, `selectedOptionId` TEXT, `isMarkedForReview` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isVisited` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isBookmarked` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sync_outbox` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `ownerId` TEXT NOT NULL, `recordId` TEXT NOT NULL, `recordType` TEXT NOT NULL, `action` TEXT NOT NULL, `payloadJson` TEXT NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `retryCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lastAttemptedAt` INTEGER, `workerId` TEXT, `claimedAt` INTEGER, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
